libraries.notice: llama.cpp and ggml (github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp, revision b11039-2-g4fea119de), compiled into the native library libmemoripple_llm.so for the on-device Local AI. The text carries llama.cpp's LICENSE, the licence of the nlohmann/json header it bundles and links, and the MIT attributions its sources state for adapted code. Reviewed from the pinned submodule and the linked symbols; cpp-httplib, subprocess.h, llguidance, llamafile and KleidiAI are not linked. It is not a Maven runtime component.
